experiment_template.research_question: Does the Round 29 H47 mechanism transfer to the complete untouched reserved partition at 8K?
stop_conditions: Confirmation outcomes may decide acceptance but may not tune a replacement confirmation run.
Every reserved identity and repetition is dispatched at most once; missing and failed rows remain zero.
No task, threshold, scorer, cap, source, closure policy, or identity changes after freeze.

records.falsifier: Any fixed confirmation criterion fails, any reserved identity disappears, any closure input is not receipt-bound pinned-base effect overlap, unknown model usage appears, or closure adds a model call or token.
records.mechanism: For each terminal response, preserve model-selected IDs as baseline and deterministically union at most six delivered pinned-base observations ranked by overlap with actual changed ranges. Score both selections from the identical response.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash untouched reserved ContextBench confirmation partition at 8K and the 96K primary token tier.
records.statement: The frozen six-item zero-model-token pinned-base effect closure reproduces at least +0.05 scheduled macro Span-F1 across the complete untouched 8K reserved confirmation partition while satisfying every fixed confirmation guard.
